approvers: my wife (co-owner), our tax adviser and lawyer, the bank
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed money wants my whole life's work and wants me to wait three years for 30 percent of the price. I am not going to spend my time on that, and my wife would not sign.
objection: No funders named, no proof of funds, a Belize company and 30 percent of the price paid over three years from a firm that has never run anything. If it fails, my staff and my retirement pay for it.
instead: Keep looking for a family or internal successor, or list the business anonymously on nexxt-change and talk to a buyer who is established and has a German bank behind them.
would_change_my_mind: A German or EU entity with named backers, a bank guarantee or escrowed proof of funds for the full price, references from earlier deals, and more of the price paid at closing.
